args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Water shoes for beach activities
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Reusable water bottle

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Quick-dry hiking pants/shorts
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirt for sun protection
- Rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Daypack/backpack
- Insect repellent

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication
- Hand sanitizer
- Toiletries
- Hairbrush/comb
- Lip balm with SPF

Electronics:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Headphones
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Memory cards for camera

Miscellaneous:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Reusable shopping bags
- Small umbrella
